name: Pomodoro
summary: A focus and break timer in the notch
description: Pick Focus or Break, drag the minute tape to any length and start the timer from the notch, or start a stopwatch. The time runs in large digits on the page, beside the notch, on the lock screen and on a Home widget that also shows on your iPhone. When a session ends it sounds, shows a notice and counts overtime until you start the next one. Add reminders and play macOS's Background Sounds while you work.
author: Sumit
